title: Decision front matter
description: The front matter of a decision document, a hypothesis's decision once it is written up; the Markdown body is the reason and is never empty. It cites the verification report and the write-up of the decision case exactly: `promote` needs that report's verdict to be `pass`, and `failed` is the decision of a hypothesis stopped after a failure, which has no verification report.

verification.description: The verification report decided on, by id and SHA-256; null for a stopped hypothesis.

writeup.description: The hypothesis's write-up, by id and SHA-256; null when the write-up was skipped.
